agency.name: American Samoa Department of Health — Behavioral Health Services Division

narrNote: No American Samoa affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched and read in-run 2026-10-22). Left null — never inferred.
notes: Per an HHS TAGGS award abstract, the American Samoa Department of Health (ASDOH) was designated the Single State Authority (SSA) for substance abuse and mental health, and delivers behavioral health services through its Behavioral Health Services Division (outpatient). The official doh.as site rendered in-run and the phone shown, (684) 633-5871, is published on it. stateCrisis null: 988 dialing is supported in American Samoa per the FCC, but no territory-published crisis line number or official crisis page could be verified in-run, so the field was left null rather than guessed. medicaidSud null: the American Samoa Medicaid office site (medicaid.as.gov) failed to resolve on two attempts (command-line fetch and browser fetch) and was excluded under the two-failed-fetches rule; no alternative official URL was guessed. two11 null: no 211 service was identified for American Samoa. peerOrgs empty: no peer/recovery community organization with a verifiable official website was found in-run. countyDirectory null: single-territory jurisdiction served directly by ASDOH.
